```js
await (async(page)=>{const results=[],errors=[];for(const[theme,mode]of[['light','primary'],['dark','dark']]){const p=await page.context().newPage();p.setDefaultTimeout(8000);p.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));await p.addInitScript(m=>localStorage.setItem('theme-mode',m),mode);for(const[view,width,height]of[['desktop',1440,1000],['mobile',390,844]]){await p.setViewportSize({width,height});await p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:5173/g/devGuild001/admin');await p.waitForTimeout(450);const screenshot='/home/qed/workspace/MonkeyScrimManager2/artifacts/ui-review/after/final-a-admin-'+theme+'-'+view+'.png';await p.screenshot({path:screenshot,fullPage:true});await p.getByRole('button',{name:/Riot 계정 관리/}).first().click();await p.waitForTimeout(400);const d=p.getByRole('dialog',{name:'Riot 계정 관리'});await d.getByRole('button',{name:'조회',exact:true}).click();await p.waitForTimeout(180);const focus=await p.evaluate(()=>({tag:document.activeElement?.tagName,text:document.activeElement?.textContent}));const invalid=await d.locator('input').getAttribute('aria-invalid');const error=await d.getByRole('alert').innerText();await p.screenshot({path:'/home/qed/workspace/MonkeyScrimManager2/artifacts/ui-review/after/final-a-admin-dialog-'+theme+'-'+view+'.png',fullPage:true});await p.keyboard.press('Escape');await p.waitForTimeout(350);await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Discord 연동',exact:true}).click();await p.waitForTimeout(450);await p.screenshot({path:'/home/qed/workspace/MonkeyScrimManager2/artifacts/ui-review/after/final-a-admin-discord-'+theme+'-'+view+'.png',fullPage:true});results.push({theme,view,focus,invalid,error,width:await p.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth)});}await p.close();}return{results,errors};})(page);
```
